channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by MITRE Corporation (mitre).

item.title: CVE-2026-90458 · 5.4 MEDIUM
item.description: OpenStack Ironic before 39.0.1 allows DELETE and GET via vendor_passthru, e.g., to delete accounts from the BMC's Redfish service.

item.title: CVE-2026-89419 · 5 MEDIUM
item.description: OpenStack Ironic before 39.0.1 sometimes allows a user to change the maintenance setting on a node via PATCH to /v1/nodes/{ident} - in other words, not using the specific maintenance endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2026-115638 · 4.3 MEDIUM
item.description: OpenStack Ironic through 39.0.1 allows a denial of service via a configdrive that results in a very large amount of uncompressed data, aka a gzip bomb.
